notes.title: The Demo is live!
notes.content: [p]Added a demo to the game. All progress will carry over to the full version of the game. Enjoy![/p]

notes.title: Screwball Is Now Available!
notes.content: [p]Hello world! Screwball is now available, and will be receiving continual support from its developer. If you find a bug in the game, please let us know and we will fix it ASAP. You can do that by posting here or sending an email to s.tipton.media@gmail.com.[/p][p][/p][p]God bless all of you, and enjoy the game![/p][p][/p][p]Scott[/p]
